text:
High school students in central Tennessee received diplomas and got soaked during torrential rain on May 21.

School officials said they expected to finish the graduation ceremony on the football field before another wave of rain moved through the area, but the downpour arrived
translated_text:
5月21日，田纳西州中部的高中生在领取毕业证书时，却在暴雨中被淋湿。

学校官员表示，他们预计能在另一波雨袭过该地区之前在足球场上完成毕业典礼，但倾盆大雨到来了

text: "What I've seen, what I've heard, is that we could balance the federal budget if the only dollars that went out of the Treasury went to individuals who were properly, lawfully, correctly eligible to receive them," White House's@StephenMsays at anti-fraud meeting with@VP.
translated_text: “我所看到、所听到的是，如果从财政部流出的唯一美元流向那些有适当、合法、正确资格接收资金的个人，我们就可以平衡联邦预算，”白宫的@StephenM 在与@VP 举行的反欺诈会议上说道。

text: "Social trust has evaporated," Trump admin's@AFergusonFTCsays, referring to thefts from stores and fraud in govt social programs.

text: The administration is proposing a policy that would have federal employees who handle "sensitive government information" sign NDAs to prevent links to the media, according to OPM

text:
NEW: President Trump calls out the violent teen takeovers in Chicago that led to five officers being hit by a car while nearly 30 people were shot in the city over Memorial Day weekend:

“五名警察受重伤。市长和州长太糟糕了。应该寻求帮助！”
